svg.text: K10 PREP BAY — wash, peel, cut and slice with bought gadgets
The bay left of the domino: sink, chute with a peeler post, a board on a lazy susan, a mandoline. No motor of its own.
bay X 0–520 · sink Ø 260 · chute 120 × 200 · board Ø 320
0 actuators: everything is moved by the 4-axis hand
peeling: spit 30–120 rpm, traversed in y, pressed 5–20 N
after prep the board zone becomes the serve and return zone
2 CHUTE + PEELER POST — side section along the spit
3 BOARD ON A LAZY SUSAN — top view
4 MANDOLINE on a GN 1/3 — side section

g.text: 1/4 Sink: potatoes washed in the pot basket under the spout; then the sleeve is rinsed by four 85 °C rim jets
2/4 Peeler post: the cucumber on the fork-spit turns and moves in y over a bought swivel peeler; peel falls into the bin
3/4 Board: the knife cuts in the y–z plane; the hand pushes a peg to turn the board 90° for the cross cuts
4/4 Mandoline: the cucumber is stroked in y over the V-blade, one slice per stroke, until the spit is 12 mm above it
